tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Use this tool when searching across all developer documentation, TypeScript SDK guides, OpenAPI specs, architectural blueprints, and runbooks by keyword. Returns ranked matching topics, counts, and relevant excerpts.

tools.name: get_documentation_page
tools.description: Use this tool when reading a specific documentation page, architecture blueprint, SDK guide, or OpenAPI 3.1 specification by topic slug. Returns the complete Markdown or JSON document content for that page.

tools.name: get_auth_protocol
tools.description: Use this tool when inspecting the public access contract, OAuth/agent authentication rules, or a specific auth.md protocol section. Returns the full auth.md Markdown contract or the requested named section.
